en: Good morning, {player}!

zh: （第 {week} 周的早上。上周排好的课开始了。）
en: (Week {week}, morning. The classes you planned begin.)

zh: （临时）这周辛苦了，下周也一起加油吧。
en: (Temp) Thanks for this week. Let's keep going next week too.

zh: 【{girl}快说累了，这一轮要自然地结束话题，比如说自己困了或想去看看小镇。】
en: [{girl} is getting tired; wrap up the topic naturally this turn, e.g. say you're sleepy or want to check the town.]
{girl}'s condition: {stats}.
{name} {value}
{name}: {text}
Classes this week: {courses}.

zh: 第 {week} 周，我们在小镇里完成了：{names}。
en: Week {week}: we finished {names} in the town.

zh: 第 {week} 周，我上得最多的是{course}。
en: Week {week}: I spent the most days on {course}.

zh: 第 {week} 周，我累倒了，生病躺了一天。
en: Week {week}: I wore myself out and was sick in bed for a day.

zh: 第 {week} 周，我心情不好，有一天没去上课。
en: Week {week}: I felt down and skipped a class.
Week {week}: {event}
My favourite {topic} is {value}.
{player} promised me: "{line}"

zh: 我在小镇的温室里第一次见到了一个真正的人。
en: I saw a real person for the first time in the town's greenhouse.

zh: 我和{player}一起种下了第一株小芽。
en: {player} and I planted our very first sprout.

zh: 我给 ARK-01 起了名字。
en: I gave ARK-01 a name.

zh: 我第一次自己修好了机器人。
en: I fixed a robot all by myself for the first time.

zh: 我跟{player}说过，我害怕一个人。
en: I told {player} I'm afraid of being alone.

zh: 我在小镇里发现了不是机器人留下的脚印。
en: I found footprints in the town that no robot made.
The gate to the industrial zone opened.

zh: 你还在为上次的事生气（{player}上次{reason}）。话很少，可以不正面回答，只说“哼”或者转开话题；{player}好好哄你，你才慢慢消气。
en: You're still upset about last time ({player} {reason}). You say very little, may dodge the question with a "hmph" or change the subject, and only soften if {player} makes it up to you.

zh: 你很困，一直打哈欠，想早点结束。
en: You're very sleepy, keep yawning and want to wrap up soon.

zh: 你心情低落，不太想说话，声音小小的。
en: You feel low, don't really want to talk, and speak quietly.

zh: 你不太信任{player}，回答敷衍，不说心里话。
en: You don't quite trust {player}; your answers are curt and you keep your feelings to yourself.

zh: 你今天心情特别好，话比平时多，想分享很多事。
en: You're in a great mood today, chattier than usual, with lots to share.
You feel calm.
({player} just brushed you off; you feel a bit let down.)

zh: （{player}刚才管着你，你有点不服气，可以说出自己的理由。）
en: ({player} just told you what to do; you're not convinced and may give your own reasons.)

zh: （{player}刚才管着你，你有点委屈，但还是会听。）
en: ({player} just told you what to do; you feel a little hurt but will listen.)
({player} just praised you; you feel shy.)
({player} just praised you; you feel proud.)

zh: （{player}刚才在关心你，你心里暖暖的。）
en: ({player} just showed they care; you feel warm inside.)
brushed you off
scolded you and wouldn't let you do things

zh: 课程教学周，小镇还没开放，你在方舟上上课
en: Class week: the town isn't open yet, you're taking classes on the ark

zh: 刚开始玩建造游戏，在维修站前清理广场、学着种东西
en: You just started the building game: clearing the repair station plaza and learning to plant

zh: 在维修站一带收集材料，想修好第一个设施
en: Gathering materials around the repair station to fix your first facility

zh: 想给工业区的锈铁大门通电，打开工业区
en: Trying to power the rusty gate and open the industrial zone

zh: 小镇里出现了奇怪的事，你觉得是游戏的 bug
en: Strange things are happening in the town; you think they're game bugs

zh: 去桥那边的温室区看看
en: Heading across the bridge to the greenhouse area

zh: 最后一周，想把温室这一小片修好
en: The final week: you want to restore the greenhouse patch

zh: 你相信小镇只是一个游戏。
en: You believe the town is just a game.

zh: 你开始怀疑小镇不只是游戏。
en: You're starting to doubt the town is just a game.
You believe Earth is real.

en: Nothing got finished in the town last week.

{name}: {text}
Right now: {hint}

zh: （下面是只有你知道的事，需要时自然地用，不要照念）
en: (Below is what only you know. Use it naturally if it fits; don't recite it.)
You remember: {items}
You know: {items}
You recently said you want to: {intent}.

zh: 现在是早上，你刚醒。对{player}说一句早安，可以带上你的心情、身体的感觉，或者上周的事。
en: It's morning and you just woke up. Say good morning to {player}; you may mention your mood, how your body feels, or last week.

zh: 这一周结束了。这周发生的事：{events}。用一句话跟{player}说说你对这周的感受。
en: The week is over. This week: {events}. In one sentence, tell {player} how you feel about the week.

zh: {player}刚把接下来 7 天的课排成：{plan}。{warning}你对这个课表说一句，可以开心、抱怨或者撒娇。
en: {player} just planned your next 7 days of classes: {plan}. {warning}Say one thing about this schedule: happy, grumbling or wheedling.
With this schedule you'll collapse on {day}.

zh: 上周{day}的{course}上发生了一件小事（不严重，比如出了个小错、发现了好玩的东西）。用一句话告诉{player}。
en: Something small happened in {course} on {day} last week (nothing serious, like a little mistake or a fun discovery). Tell {player} in one sentence.

zh: 你正在{activity}。{player}在旁边没说话。你主动对{player}说一句，可以和你正在做的事有关。{memory}
en: You are {activity}. {player} is nearby, quiet. Say something to {player} on your own; it can be about what you're doing. {memory}
You suddenly remember: {text}

刚才你们的对话：{lines}
用第一人称写一句话，记下这次聊了什么和你的感受，不超过 30 字。
en:
Your conversation just now:{lines}
In the first person, write one sentence noting what you talked about and how you felt, under 25 words.

daydreaming with your chin in your hand
gazing at Earth through the window
fussing over the little potted plant on the desk
drawing
playing with a robot model
counting the stars outside
writing town-planning notes
fixing an old part
browsing the old Earth archive

en: (You can tell: {player} {attitude}, and {wants}. Reply accordingly.)
is encouraging you

is comforting you
